variants.classic:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: layered game UI compass medallion candidate. Pixar-like 3D animated film still, product-shot of a single object, centred, strict straight-on front view, orthographic circular geometry, soft studio lighting, warm brass and deep navy palette, high detail, crisp edges, genuinely transparent RGBA background. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no cardinal letters, no logos, no people. Square 2048 by 2048 requested. Keep the whole object inside the canvas with 5 percent clear margin. The circular dial is centred at x=50%,y=50%. Outer circular brass perimeter radius=44% of canvas; socket centres follow radius=36.5%. Precisely SEVENTEEN small EMPTY five-point star-shaped sockets form one evenly-spaced ring, first socket exactly at the top at 12 o'clock, the remaining 16 evenly spaced clockwise by 360/17 degrees. Each socket star outer radius=2.7% of canvas, dark recessed bronze, unlit, all same size. Empty sockets are clearly visible and countable, NO lit stars and NO other decorative stars around the ring. Keep dial clear and easy to read when scaled to 280px on a child's phone. One compass object only.
Variant: An antique brass explorer's compass medallion, thick polished brass outer rim with engraved rope pattern, deep navy enamel dial with a simple gold eight-point compass rose, slender red-and-gold needle, gentle wear, warm highlights. Timeless nautical exploration, elegant craftsmanship, tidy detailing.
